edges.reason: Constructor assigns admin = msg.sender, letting the deployer control the administrator state variable.
_setPendingImplementation returns UNAUTHORIZED when msg.sender != admin, gating the privileged write.
_acceptImplementation requires msg.sender == pendingWanFarmImplementation and non-zero before activating the implementation.
_setPendingAdmin returns UNAUTHORIZED when msg.sender != admin, gating the privileged write.
_acceptAdmin requires msg.sender == pendingAdmin before promoting the caller to admin.
newPendingImplementation parameter is stored into pendingWanFarmImplementation.
newPendingAdmin parameter is stored into pendingAdmin.
wanFarmImplementation state is read for logging and replaced by the newly accepted implementation.
pendingWanFarmImplementation is consumed by _acceptImplementation to update the implementation and is cleared afterwards.
pendingAdmin is read by _acceptAdmin to update admin and is cleared afterwards.
admin state variable is overwritten with pendingAdmin during _acceptAdmin.
The payable fallback unconditionally performs the delegatecall to the implementation.
The delegatecall target address is the wanFarmImplementation state variable, so an unset or malicious implementation is executed.
_setPendingImplementation invokes fail() to report UNAUTHORIZED on a failed caller check.
_acceptImplementation invokes fail() to report UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not the pending implementation.
_setPendingAdmin invokes fail() to report UNAUTHORIZED on a failed caller check.
_acceptAdmin invokes fail() to report UNAUTHORIZED when the caller is not the pending admin.
pendingWanFarmImplementation is copied into the local oldPendingImplementation_set before being overwritten.
wanFarmImplementation is copied into the local oldImplementation inside _acceptImplementation.
pendingWanFarmImplementation is copied into the local oldPendingImplementation_accept inside _acceptImplementation.
pendingAdmin is copied into the local oldPendingAdmin_set before being overwritten in _setPendingAdmin.
admin is copied into the local oldAdmin inside _acceptAdmin.
pendingAdmin is copied into the local oldPendingAdmin_accept inside _acceptAdmin.
The delegatecall executes attacker-influenced code from the implementation contract while this contract's storage is exposed, allowing reentrant manipulation of admin/implementation state.
